question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select ‘No substitution’.

He was the fastest __between __all the contestants.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"between"** is typically used when referring to two entities or items. (के बीच )

 
 
• **Example: **The negotiations **between** the two companies were successful.
 
 
 
• **"Amongst" **is used when referring to more than two entities or items. (के बीच में)
 
 
• **Example: **He was the fastest** amongst **all the contestants.
 
 

Hence, in the given context, where there are multiple contestants, **'amongst' **is the correct word to use.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Since **(से): Used to indicate a point in time in the past until now.

 
 
• **Example:** She has been working here since 2010.
 
 
 
• **From** (से): Indicates the point in time at which a particular process, event, or activity starts.
 
 
• **Example: **The store is open from 9 AM to 9 PM.
